name: maestro
description: Route tasks to project skill bundles with /maestro, refresh bundle keywords with /maestro-fetch, and change the saved bundle folder with /maestro-set.

interface.longDescription: Maestro chooses the right skill bundle for a task from a saved user-provided folder, can refresh its bundle keyword index, and can switch the saved bundle folder.
defaultPrompt: Use $maestro to route this task to the right skill bundle.
Use $maestro-fetch to refresh bundle keywords from my saved skill-bundle-folder.
